info.name: LMS-13 | UC7.1 Local User Administration
info.description: Verification of GET /api/admin/users and PATCH /api/admin/users/{userId}. See docs/admin-user-management.md for the implemented contract, fixtures and test commands. Set the four collection variables locally; tokens must not include the Bearer prefix. baseUrl defaults to port 8080 as requested, but the LMS application defaults to port 8081. Use a disposable fixture database with exactly one ACTIVE ADMINISTRATOR, a separate ACTIVE STUDENT token subject, and a third non-admin target. Run one iteration in order: the target ends as ACTIVE/TUTOR. 2.5 preflights the active-admin count and skips its PATCH with a failing test if the fixture is wrong. Empty object/null fields are valid PATCH no-ops; 2.6 tests absent body, whole-body null and malformed values instead. No credentials are included.

variable.description: LMS origin without trailing slash. Override to http://localhost:8081 for the application default.
Local-only JWT for an ACTIVE local ADMINISTRATOR; omit Bearer prefix.
Local-only JWT for a separate ACTIVE local STUDENT, distinct from target_user_id; omit Bearer prefix.
Existing disposable non-admin UUID, distinct from both token subjects. Mutations leave this user ACTIVE/TUTOR.

item.name: 2.5 Last-Active-Admin Protection
item.description: Requires exactly one ACTIVE ADMINISTRATOR. Before each PATCH, a read-only authenticated preflight checks this and derives last_active_admin_id without changing target_user_id. A missing prerequisite fails an assertion and skips the mutation. Use a runtime supporting pm.execution.skipRequest(). Run with other administrator writers idle; this preflight is not a transaction or a concurrency test.
